nicknames: Home of the Goulburn Cup & Guy Walter Stakes

main_turf.surface: Turf (Cool-climate Rye and Couch grass on deep free-draining sandy loam)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Widely regarded as one of the finest, fairest galloping surfaces in New South Wales outside Metropolitan Sydney. Features a symmetrical 1,750m oval, a broad 24-metre width, sweeping cambered turns, and a testing 400-metre home straight. Because of the wide 24m expanse and long 400m run-in, weak front-runners ('E') cannot hide late — tactical pressers ('P') and sustained big-striding swoopers ('S' and 'C') have every chance to reel in leaders.
main_turf.post_bias: ULTRA-FAIR CHUTE GEOMETRY: Goulburn utilizes two massive starting chutes at 1000m and 1600m (plus 1400m/1500m extensions) that provide long, straight runs of 450m-600m before the first bend. Do NOT heavily penalize wide barrier draws (9+) in 1000m, 1400m, or 1600m chute starts (cap penalty at -1 pt max).

handicapping_angles.sydney_metro_and_warwick_farm_strike_zon: Situated just 1 hour down the Hume Highway from Warwick Farm and Kembla Grange, Goulburn is a primary target for top Sydney Metropolitan stables (Bjorn Baker, Waterhouse & Bott, Annabel Neasham & Rob Archibald, Chris Waller, Ciaron Maher, Richard & Will Freedman, Brad Widdup, Matthew Smith) debuting blue-blood maidens or dropping benchmark horses for confidence wins. Heavily upgrade Sydney Metro/Provincial shippers (+3.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.championship_24m_width_and_400m_swooper_: Over the 24m-wide, 400m home straight, horses with top L600m/L400m closing sectionals ('P' and 'S' styles) regularly overpower one-paced leaders in the final 150m (+2.5 pts sectional stamina angle).
handicapping_angles.1000m_and_1600m_long_chute_wide_draw_for: In 1000m sprints and 1600m mile races out of the long chutes, horses drawn wide (barriers 8-14) have ample straight runway to find cover or press forward without being trapped 3-wide on a turn.
handicapping_angles.local_goulburn_and_canberra_specialist_y: Respect strong home-track Goulburn trainers (Danielle Seib, Danny Williams, Kurt Goldman, Tash Burleigh, Pat Murphy, Scott Collings) and neighboring Canberra raiders (Matthew Dale, Keith Dryden, Norm Gardner) when well-supported.
handicapping_angles.goulburn_cup_and_guy_walter_showcase_cla: Home of the Goulburn Cup ($200k Showcase / Big Dance Eligibility Qualifier) and Group 2/3-producing Guy Walter Stakes. Feature meetings run at full Saturday Midweek Metro / Provincial speed pars.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 2.5 (NSW Premier Southern Tablelands Showcase HQ)
